definitions: To pay close attention to what is happening and being said in order to get information about something.
To be well-informed about current trends, opinions, or developments.
examples: She always keeps an ear to the ground for new job opportunities.
If you want to know what's really going on, you need to have an ear to the ground.
He keeps an ear to the ground for any changes in market sentiment.
synonyms: keep one's ear to the ground
have an ear to the ground
